notes.title: Release Update
notes.content: [p]Dear followers,[/p][p][/p][p]I am grateful for each of the 150 people who currently have [i]Purrfect Galaxies[/i] on their wishlist. It means a lot to me and gives me hope that someone out there is interested in my little game.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Unfortunately, I have to announce that I won’t be able to meet the original release date on World Cat Day, August 8th, 2025, as I am currently going through the hardest time of my 36-year life and have lost the most precious thing I ever had. I am mentally exhausted and don’t know if this battle will have a good outcome.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]My new goal is to release [i]Purrfect Galaxies[/i] on World Cat Day 2026.[/p][p]Thank you very much for your understanding and patience![/p][p][/p][p]– Dev from GalacticWhiskerWare[/p]

notes.title: UPDATE
notes.content:
I'm making progress on 'Purrfect Galaxies', but honestly I can't promise it'll be done by World Cat Day on August 8th this year. 2025 has been such a dark year for me. I pushed myself too hard at work, and I completely snapped. Now my personal life is in shambles. It's more than any one person should have to bear. So I'm not going to push myself past my limits just to get the game done. I also want 'Purrfect Galaxies to come out in good shape – not buggy or half-finished. Maybe I shouldn't have gotten so caught up in my side projects, either. Anyway, they're now available on the Play Store. Check them out if you feel like it.

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=org.gww.meowglider
